_comment: The interpreter is resolved by fallback because no single name works everywhere: Debian/Ubuntu often has no 'python', and on Windows 'python3' is a Microsoft Store stub that exits 9009 without running anything. Both hooks are guaranteed to exit 0 (see tests/test_sensor.py::test_hook_never_crashes_on_garbage_input), so '||' can only fire when the interpreter itself failed to launch - never because the hook did its job and reported a problem. Order matters: python3 first so macOS/Linux never falls through, then py for Windows, then python.
